headline: Amazon has cut roles across several teams in a new round of layoffs.
score_reason: Pool 7, lowered 1: the cuts happened on 6 Oct 2026, before 7 Oct (stale rule).
importance_line: It affects Amazon staff in customer service, marketplace support and engineering in several countries, including India and the UK, and the total is unconfirmed beyond Amazon's 'small number' and an unnamed person's figure of fewer than 1,000.
summary: Business Insider reports that Amazon cut roles across several teams on Tuesday, 6 Oct 2026, after employees described the cuts in an internal Slack channel. Amazon confirmed a small number of roles were cut, mainly in its Stores business, while it prepares to spend a record $220 billion on AI infrastructure; a person familiar with the matter says fewer than 1,000 employees were affected.
